on_restart_event: 1. Check manage_subagents list to identify idle conversation IDs.
2. Read .agents/subagents_manifest.json to look up the subagent's assigned milestones and revival_instruction.
3. Send revival message via send_message using revival_instruction + current milestone context.
4. If a subagent process was destroyed completely, re-spawn via invoke_subagent with the saved state.
5. Check and re-register any required background tasks/crons.
